sentences.text:
-----
Coram Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Shankar

-----
 For the Petitioner: Mr. A. Sriwastava

For the State: Mr. A. K. Thakur, A.C to A.A.G-Iii
 -----
04/16.08.2023

A counter affidavit was filed on behalf of the respondent Nos. 1 to 5  24.02.2022, relevant paragraphs of which read as under:
"10.

That it is stated that vide Annexure-2 series of the writ petition, on receipt of the requisition from the requisition department (Executive Engineer, Road Circle,
Ranchi). On receipt of the requisition, the answering respondent sent the same to the concerned Amin for necessary verification and on receipt of the same from the concerned Amin, when the answering respondent found the requisition to be in order, the same was registered as L. A. Case No. 147/2017-18 and accordingly published preliminary notification under Section 11(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition (Rehabilitation and Resettlement) Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition (Rehabilitation and Resettlement) Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Further, it is stated that the said requisition lapsed its force on expiration of 01 year by efflux of law, due to non-release of estimated fund for preparation of award from the requisitioning department (Executive Engineer, Road Construction Department, Road Division, Ranchi).
11.

That it is stated that again a fresh requisition for acquisition of land concerning construction of road and bridge from Village- Bara Ghaghra to Namkum area has been received from the requisition department (Executive Engineer, Road Circle,
Ranchi).

On receipt of the same, the matter has been referred to the concerned Amin Santosh Kujur vs The State Of Jharkhand & Others on 16 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40839254/
1 for necessary verification.

entities.text: Amin Santosh Kujur vs The State Of Jharkhand & Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On receipt of the report, the answering respondent would carry out necessary formality in the matter.
12. That it is most humbly stated and submitted that it is clear that the process of acquisition of the land is at the initial stage.

Notification under Section 11(1) of the L.
A. Act., 2013 is yet to be published.

It is further stated that only after publication of notification under Section 11(1) is done, further proceeding under Sections 19, 23 &
26 for publication of award in lieu of acquisition of land will be done as such it may be safely said that the instant writ petition is premature one."

Since the counter affidavit was filed on behalf of the said respondents about one and half years back,
the present status of the fresh land acquisition is not available on record.

Hence, the respondent Nos. 1 to 5 are directed to file a supplementary counter affidavit within three weeks clearly stating the present status of fresh acquisition proceeding with respect to acquisition of the lands situated at Mouza-Bara Ghaghra, Circle-Namkum, District-Ranchi.

Put up this case on 18.09.2023 under the heading 'For Admission'.
Satish/- (RAJESH SHANKAR, J)
